title: Transport of a monoidal comparison diagram
statement: Let C and E be monoidal categories, C0 a category, R:C→E and Q:C0→E functors, and μ(A,B):R(A)⊗R(B)→R(A⊗B) a family natural in both arguments. Let a:A→K and b:B→L be isomorphisms, x:U→R(K), y:V→R(L), m:K⊗L→M, f:M→N, w:N→O and d:A⊗B→O with d=(a⊗b)≫m≫f≫w. Let c:U⊗V→Q(P), ν:P→T, g:T→Z, β:Q(T)→R(M), γ:Q(Z)→R(N). If (x⊗y)≫μ(K,L)≫R(m)=c≫Q(ν)≫β and Q(g)≫γ=β≫R(f), then ((x≫R(a⁻¹))⊗(y≫R(b⁻¹)))≫μ(A,B)≫R(d)=c≫Q(ν≫g)≫γ≫R(w), where ≫ denotes composition in the indicated order.

proof.text: Rewrite d by hd, use lax monoidal naturality for the inverse augmentation maps, append R.map f and R.map w to hdiag, and use hcomp to replace Q.map g followed by gamma.
